_comment: C0-15 gpt4all bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（jan/ollama），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [openai-agents-sdk]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Official model catalog (the GPT4All-format .ggjt/.gguf line) + local import; catalog availability shifts with the maintenance cadence — not inventoried item by item.
axes.runtime: Desktop app (Windows/macOS/Linux); built on the llama.cpp line. GitHub 77,351★, last push 2025-05-27 (GitHub API verified 2026-10-21 — the release slowdown is a fact, recorded as such).
axes.local_files: Models and conversations land on your machine by default; the official stance is local running, no official cloud line seen (unlike Ollama's cloud line).
axes.background: A built-in local API server line can be connected by external clients; its current status and default switch not verified item by item.
axes.tools: In-app chat is the main axis; no official main line seen for an agent/tool-calling ecosystem, and the third-party extension surface is not verified item by item.
axes.context: Session context management is in-app; cross-session memory and long-term memory capability — no official statement seen (not-verified ≠ absent).
axes.permissions: Desktop-app permissions follow the OS grant; no account system, no cloud-sync permission surface (no official cloud-line statement seen).
axes.fit: Fits: running small models on low-spec machines (CPU-first), wanting a MIT no-strings desktop solution. Does not fit: wanting new models out of the box (maintenance cadence has slowed — check the repo's last push); wanting service deployment.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the local-endpoint and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no runner-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The current usable list of the official model catalog (not inventoried item by item)
- An official explanation of the maintenance slowdown (none seen — only repo facts recorded, no guessing at causes)
- The current status of the built-in API server (not verified item by item)
related: Both open-source desktop GUIs: Jan is actively maintained, GPT4All wins on CPU low-spec friendliness and a clean MIT license.
The current mainstream entry; GPT4All's historical place is "the earliest to get ordinary people running".
